item.title: Version 2.2.0
item.description:
Changed

  • The MeetingView icon in the menu bar now has the colour you chose for the app icon, and changes as soon as you pick another. It appears when the menu-bar icon is set to "MeetingView" in Preferences → Display & Events, and whenever MeetingView shows its own icon, such as before any calendar is selected.

item.title: Version 2.1.0
item.description:
Added

  • A new app icon, in six colours. Choose yours in Preferences → General → App icon: blue (the default), green, purple, pink, yellow or graphite. Your choice appears in MeetingView's windows, alerts and update prompts. Finder and notifications always show the blue icon.

Changed

  • The "MeetingView" menu-bar icon matches the new app icon.

item.title: Version 2.0.0
item.description:
MeetingView 2.0 is a complete rebuild. It does the same job, with the same settings, on a new foundation.

Added

  • Right-click the menu-bar item to join the current or next meeting straight away.
  • The menu has a join item for the current or next meeting at the top.
  • A long meeting title that doesn't fit in the menu bar now falls back to the icon alone, so the item never disappears.

Changed

  • MeetingView now requires macOS 14 or later.
  • The app's language is chosen in System Settings → General → Language & Region → Applications. Preferences → General has a button that opens it. A language picked in 1.x carries over.

Removed

  • The Advanced tab in Preferences, and with it Shortcut hooks, AppleScript hooks and regex filters.
